tools.name: sl_env
tools.title: Session info
tools.description: Report which MATLAB/Simulink session is in use: version, working folder, whether the desktop is running, and which Simulink products are licensed.

detail.description: "full" also lists every installed toolbox; "" returns a summary.

tools.name: sl_set_folder
tools.title: Change folder
tools.description: Change the MATLAB working folder.

folder.description: Absolute folder path that must already exist.

tools.name: sl_new
tools.title: New model
tools.description: Create a new blank Simulink model.

name.description: Model name, used as the block path prefix ("mymodel").

save_path.description: "" leaves the model unsaved; otherwise an .slx path to save it to.

tools.name: sl_open
tools.title: Open model
tools.description: Load an existing .slx model from disk and report its top-level block count.

tools.name: sl_save
tools.title: Save model
tools.description: Save a loaded model.

save_path.description: "" reuses the model's own file; otherwise an .slx path.

tools.name: sl_close
tools.title: Close model
tools.description: Close a loaded model.

do_save.description: true saves before closing; false discards changes.

tools.name: sl_list_models
tools.title: List loaded models
tools.description: List the models and libraries currently loaded in the session.

pattern.description: "" for all, otherwise a regexp matched against names.

tools.name: sl_blocks
tools.title: List blocks
tools.description: List blocks with their full paths and BlockTypes.

depth.description: -1 for every level, 1 for top level only.

type_filter.description: "" for all, otherwise a BlockType such as "Gain" or "Scope".

tools.name: sl_ports
tools.title: Ports of a block
tools.description: Report a block's port counts per kind and which ports already have a line attached. Call this before wiring a multi-output block.

tools.name: sl_lines
tools.title: List connections
tools.description: List every connection as source block and port to destination block and port.

tools.name: sl_trace
tools.title: Trace signal chain
tools.description: Follow the signal into or out of one block, returning the blocks, the port-to-port edges and one line per hop. Use it to read a large model one path at a time instead of listing every line.

block.description: Block to start from: full path or a name relative to the model.

direction.description: "upstream" (where its input comes from) or "downstream" (where its output goes); "" means upstream.

depth.description: How many hops to follow; <=0 means 3.

tools.name: sl_block_params
tools.title: Block parameters
tools.description: Read a block's dialog parameters with their current values.

filter.description: "" for all parameters, otherwise a regexp on parameter names.

tools.name: sl_lib_search
tools.title: Search block library
tools.description: Search the built-in Simulink library for block paths. Use this instead of guessing a library path for sl_add_block.

query.description: Substring or regexp matched against library block paths, e.g. "Gain" or "PID".

tools.name: sl_add_block
tools.title: Add block
tools.description: Add a library block to a model. Get the library path from sl_lib_search rather than inventing one.

destination.description: Target path in the model, e.g. "mymodel/Gain1".

position.description: "left top right bottom" in pixels, or "" to place it at the right edge.

tools.name: sl_add_line
tools.title: Connect ports
tools.description: Wire one output port to one input port.

src_block.description: Source block path relative to the model, e.g. "Step".

dst_block.description: Destination block path relative to the model, e.g. "Gain".

tools.name: sl_delete
tools.title: Delete block or close model
tools.description: Delete a block together with its connected lines. If given a loaded model name, closes that model instead.

target.description: Full block path, or a loaded model name.

tools.name: sl_delete_line
tools.title: Disconnect ports
tools.description: Remove the connection between two ports.

src_block.description: Source block path relative to the model.

dst_block.description: Destination block path relative to the model.

tools.name: sl_set_param
tools.title: Set parameter
tools.description: Set a parameter on a block or on a model (solver, StopTime, ...) and report the previous value.

target.description: Block path or loaded model name.

value.description: New value as text, e.g. "2.5" or "[1 2]".

tools.name: sl_layout
tools.title: Auto layout
tools.description: Re-position every block into a flow layout ordered by signal direction. Use it after adding blocks, which otherwise pile up at the origin.

tools.name: sl_update
tools.title: Compile check
tools.description: Compile the model (Update Diagram) to surface wiring, port, data-type and solver errors without running a simulation. On failure it also reports the blocks named in the diagnostic and a hint for the next call.

tools.name: sl_last_error
tools.title: Last MATLAB error
tools.description: Return the last uncaught MATLAB error with its message and stack.

clear_flag.description: true also clears the recorded error.

tools.name: sl_sim
tools.title: Run simulation
tools.description: Simulate the model and summarise the result. The SimulationOutput stays in the base workspace as simOut for sl_sim_data and sl_plot.

stop_time.description: "" keeps the model value; otherwise a number of seconds such as "10".

solver.description: "" keeps the model value; otherwise a solver such as "ode45".

tools.name: sl_sim_data
tools.title: Read simulation data
tools.description: Read a field of the last simOut as JSON arrays, downsampled to keep the payload small.

variable.description: Plain identifier, e.g. "yout" or "tout" or a logged signal name.

tools.name: sl_metrics
tools.title: Signal metrics
tools.description: Characterise the last simulated signal: steady state, overshoot, rise time, settling time and steady-state error against a reference. Saves reading numbers off a plot by eye.

variable.description: Field of simOut such as "yout" or "yout{2}"; "" uses the first output.

reference.description: The value the signal should settle at, as text, so a steady-state error can be computed; "" skips that comparison.

band_percent.description: Settling-time band as a percentage of the step size; <=0 means 2.

tools.name: sl_snapshot
tools.title: Model diagram PNG
tools.description: Export the model diagram itself to a PNG so the built model can be looked at.

out_path.description: "" writes to the MATLAB temp folder; otherwise a .png path.

tools.name: sl_plot
tools.title: Plot signal PNG
tools.description: Plot a simulated signal to a PNG.

signal.description: Field of simOut, e.g. "yout" or a logged signal name.

out_path.description: "" writes to the MATLAB temp folder; otherwise a .png path.

tools.name: sl_show
tools.title: Show model window
tools.description: Open the model in the Simulink editor so it is visible on screen while it is being built.

tools.name: sl_highlight
tools.title: Highlight block
tools.description: Mark one block in red in the Simulink editor so the next sl_snapshot shows where to look. An empty block clears every mark in the model.

block.description: Full block path or a name relative to the model; "" clears all marks.

tools.name: sl_cleanup
tools.title: Remove dangling lines
tools.description: Delete orphaned line segments left behind by block deletion, which otherwise keep a port occupied and break the next connection.

tools.name: sl_selftest
tools.title: Self-test
tools.description: Prove the toolchain works end to end in a throwaway model: engine, library paths, block creation, wiring, compile, simulate, read data, metrics, snapshot, save and error reporting. Leaves nothing behind.

folder.description: Scratch folder for the test model and PNG; "" uses the MATLAB temp folder.

tools.name: sl_subsystem
tools.title: Group into subsystem
tools.description: Group blocks into a subsystem, or expand one back. Use it when a diagram has grown unreadable or when a repeated motif should become one block. Simulink creates the ports it needs and keeps the inner wiring; pass several blocks at once and they become one subsystem.

blocks.description: Comma-separated block paths, model-relative ("Gain1") or full. For mode "expand" pass exactly one subsystem path.

name.description: Name for the new subsystem; "" keeps the generated one.

mode.description: "group" (default) packs the blocks; "expand" pulls a subsystem's contents back to the top level.

tools.name: sl_build
tools.title: Build from spec
tools.description: Create or extend a model from a JSON spec: blocks (library path or plain type), their parameters, positions and connections. Missing blocks are added, existing ones keep their place and get their parameters updated, so rerunning the same spec is safe. Prefer this over many sl_add_block calls when building more than a few blocks.

model.description: Model name; created when it is neither loaded nor on disk.

spec.description: Path to a .json spec file, or the JSON text itself: {"params":{...},"blocks":[{"name":"ref","type":"Step","params":{"Time":"0"},"pos":[30,40,70,80]}],"lines":[{"from":"ref/1","to":"gain/1"}]}. "lib" may replace "type" for an exact library path.

layout.description: "true" re-lays the diagram out afterwards; "" or "false" keeps the spec positions.
